About This Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on, detailed Accounting Specialist to join our growing finance and accounting team reporting to our Senior Accounting Manager. The ideal candidate is excited to work with ERP systems, procurement, payables systems, the General Ledger (GL), and reconciliations and thrives in a fast-paced, scaling AI software/technology environment.

This role will play a critical part in supporting day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, travel & expense, cash management, prepaids, and accruals, while helping to ensure financial integrity and operational efficiency.


What You Will Do

  • Support the accounts payable process, including invoice entry, approval workflows, and timely payments using systems, such as Bill.com.
  • Support the travel & expense process in Navan, helping to enforce our travel and expense policies, and perform the reconciliations for the associated Navan liability accounts in ERP systems.
  • Manage cash activity, including uploading bank statements, cash match and bank reconciliations.
  • Support month-end close activities, including preparation of journal entries and account reconciliations for various accounts related to accounts payable and cash.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records and assist with 1099 reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams (e.g., Engineering, Sales, FP&A, People Ops) to ensure accurate classification of expenses and timely processing of invoices.
  • Contribute to cash management and forecasting with timely data management.
  • Help implement and maintain strong internal controls and accounting best practices.
  • Assist with financial audits and compliance initiatives as required.
  • Identify and support automation opportunities and system improvements to scale accounting operations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 2–5 years of general accounting experience, preferably in the software or technology industry.
  • Experience in ERP systems, such as NetSuite, SAP S/4Hana (Cloud), Campfire, Rillet and procure-to-pay systems, such as Bill.com or Ramp.
  • Knowledge of US GAAP and a solid understanding of core accounting principles
  • Advanced Excel skills (such as pivot tables, VLOOKUP, SUMIF, etc.) and comfort with cloud-based financial tools.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally in a collaborative environment.
How to Stand Out From the Crowd
  • Experience with multi-entity or international operations.
  • CPA or CPA-track is a plus.
  • Experience with financial automation or ERP optimization projects.
  • SaaS (Software as a Service) experience
  • Experience with monthly balance sheet and income statement flux analysis
  • Prior experience with T&E systems, such as Navan, Expensify, or Concur

Why H2O.ai?

  • Market leader in total rewards
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Flexible working environment
  • Be part of a world-class team
  • Career growth
The base salary for this role ranges from $65,000 to $85,000 CAD. Compensation is determined based on several factors, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and relevant market compensation data.
 
H2O.ai is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status or any other legally protected basis.
